causal_diagnosis.bug: SurfaceRegion V3 stored token_candidate_limit and core_token_fraction in its contract and digest but bounded strict expansion at maximum_tokens; a dense core could consume all 256 settled candidates before the context shell was observed.
causal_diagnosis.consequence: The claimed core-plus-context representation was often effectively core-only, so the readout could not learn the intended object-local contextual correction.
causal_diagnosis.frozen_v3_policy: V3 code, digest, and dense-core behavior remain immutable; the correction is a new contract version.

unchanged: geometry-16 tensor layout and direction-plus-log-raw-norm gauge
fixed teacher target protocol for the first canary

stage_1.scope: one four-scene query-free ScanNet validation shard with the exact existing schema-1 fixed-core teacher tensors
stage_1.purpose: verify cache integrity and prove that context capacity is materially present
required: all rows satisfy the minimum-token contract
core, context, support-fill, and padding masks are mutually consistent
single and batch expansion remain exact
teacher tensors are byte-identical to the replay authority
no benchmark scene, vocabulary, label, instance, or mask is opened

stage_2.scope: all eight held-out query-free ScanNet validation scenes
stage_2.purpose: evaluate the immutable V2-compatible safe base before any residual training
stage_2.floor_source: matched fixed-core V2 control 0.9429590106010437 minus frozen 0.002 noninferiority margin

stage_3.scope: train-only V4 residual candidate with centered text and visual response objectives
stage_3.opening_rule: only after stages 1 and 2 pass; benchmark remains closed until all target-blind generic gates pass

teacher_schema2_rule.reason: best-view selection and factorized teacher evidence are a separate causal variable and require their own replay/cache comparison
